text_block_list.text:
Upon coming to observe a certain live 
performance—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*... I wonder if I'll be able to do 
well in the live show...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san, you will be entirely fine! 
There is no issue whatsoever, rest fully 
assured!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For you took a magnificent 1st place in 
today's race! Overtaking none other than 
me, the class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you should have immense 
confidence! After all, you surpassed me of 
all people!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha. But, I wonder if I can properly 
convey my gratitude to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san, all that is left now is... to 
dash forward with BAKUSHIN!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, together! Our glorious rallying cry!! 
Let's...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIINNN—
(*Riiip...*)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
............Um, didn't that sound like 
something tearing just now...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Eh? Eh? Eh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bakushin O-san! The back of your skirt 
has ripped a tiny bit...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What in the world!? Where, where is it!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, stay still please! If you move, it'll 
spread!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, could it be that my Bakushin pose was 
so vigorous that the fabric simply could 
not withstand it!?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower-san, Sakura Bakushin O-san, 
5 minutes until showtime!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa, what a catastrophe!? I cannot 
take the stage in an imperfect state!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —I'll fix it!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh, Flower-san!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
With my speed, I can grab my sewing kit 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And if I sew it quickly right after, we'll 
make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What!? In time!? We will make it in 
timeee!?!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san, please calm down. The 
important thing is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: 'Composure'!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —...All done! Your skirt is fixed!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Haa*~... We made it in time~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Such a straight seam! 
Incredible, Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Precise, magnificent, and above all, 
speedy! This reliability is worthy of a 
class president!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... While sewing, my feelings settled 
down too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The important thing is 'composure'... 
Thanks to that, I was able to remember.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now I can properly convey my gratitude to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
However, since I was in a rush, the 
stitching might be a little loose...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So please try not to move too violently—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Flower-san!! The class 
president has made a complete comeback!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, straight to the stage we go!! 
LET'S BAKUSHIIINNN!!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, please wait!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I haven't taken out the sewing pins yet~!
